title: Resolution urging Albany to widen who can get disability rent exemption
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass S.3563/A.10927, which would let other qualifying household members, such as a parent or guardian, be counted as head of household to establish eligibility for the Disability Rent Increase Exemption. Currently DRIE eligibility can be denied when the person with a disability is not formally the lease's head of household. The change aims to protect households from losing rent protections due to this definition.
